'''Maggs''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] student during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who trained at the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith Academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]].

==Biography==
After the outbreak of the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Sickness]] at the Academy, Maggs teamed up with fellow students [[Hartwig]], [[Kindra]] and [[Mnah Ra'at]] and the [[Combat Master|Sith Combat Master]] [[Xat Hracken]]. Hracken, Hartwig and Ra'at died, leaving only Maggs and Kindra. Realizing the [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] Sith were after them, Kindra severed Maggs' Achilles tendons with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], immobilizing him and leaving him to [[Death/Legends|die]]. Maggs had no idea why Kindra would do this to him, and he would be the one to die. He looked down, and was eaten to death by the zombies.<ref name="Red Harvest" />
